'''March 2001 Joliet tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Joliet, Illinois on 24 March 2001. [[Edmund Gray]] won it. It is known from Edmund Gray's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1952">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-25-joliet-3-24-01d1952/ joliet-3-24-01], DeckTech (edmund "edmund" gray, 25 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-25-joliet-3-24-01d1952/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 24 March 2001
* '''Site:''' Joliet, Illinois
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Edmund Gray]]
